summary: Deep audit of documentary, education, aftermath, sandbox, viewshed, regiment and ground-remembers (plus site-nav shared code and every data file they fetch), 53 findings, full long-form report with per-page fix specs, time-model appendix (four conflicting tick-to-clock formulas plus chronology drift tables), a measured H8 feasibility study, shared-module spec and test plan. Headline results, all evidence-backed: (1) every "See it on the map" deep link from these pages (?tick=, ?unit=, ?vignette=) is dead because the deployed bundle's only URL-query reader is ?ancestor=; (2) the three Mapbox pages block first paint on a synchronous 481 KB-gzip / 1.8 MB mapbox-gl.js and create the map only after 9 serial fetches (root cause of S2 blank ~3 s); (3) Documentary renders 24/24 multi-paragraph narratives as one paragraph; (4) Regimental Biography's vignette-mention join finds 1 of 467 regiments, shows empty timelines for 444/467 units though 422 have brigade-level placements, and never loads 103 artillery batteries; (5) Sandbox's edit panel is mis-positioned, drag is mouse-only (no touch/keyboard, WCAG 2.5.7), disposition control mislabels 3 real dispositions, and all three scenario labels contradict the data by clock and event order; (6) terrain.json coordinates/elevations disagree with USGS 3DEP (mean abs 62 ft, 13/30 off >50 ft, Big Round Top point is 365 m from the summit), so the current ranking is unreliable; (7) a real viewshed is feasible: USGS 3DEP 1 m lidar DEM is public domain, 10 m terrain-RGB PNG is 0.54 MB (5 m is 1.65 MB), ray-casting runs in 44-240 ms in Node/V8, 5 m vs 10 m results differ by <=1.4 points, and Mapbox terrain-DEM must be used for rendering only (SDK-only, derivative-data restriction per docs summary); (8) Ground Remembers' heat reflects keyframe authoring density (21% non-combat keyframes; top hotspot flips from The Angle to Culp's Hill when duration-weighted); (9) og:image on all pages is a malformed PNG identical for Day 1 and Day 3. Nothing was verified by running the pages (browser tools off-limits), so layout claims are tagged [C]/[U] with acceptance tests.

findings.title: Deep links from these pages into the map are dead
findings.evidence: documentary.html:92, education.html:81, regiment.html:247 emit /index.html?tick=..&vignette=.. and /?unit=..&tick=..; search/turning-points/historian emit the same. The only location.search reader in the deployed app is bundle.pretty.js:101019 (get("ancestor")); bookmark writer bundle.pretty.js:97822-97830 emits t,u,z,ll which nothing reads; no reader in index.html; Jun 13 and Jul 20 deploys identical.
findings.root_cause: Pages built against an assumed URL contract the app never implemented; app share links use a second, unread contract.
findings.fix: Define URL contract v1 (?tick=&day=&unit=&vignette=&lat=&lng=&z=, accept legacy t,u,z,ll). App side: parse before onboarding, set currentTick (bundle.pretty.js:9362), select unit, open vignette, fly to lat/lng, skip splash when a deep link is present; minimal no-source patch: replace initial currentTick:1 with __gtbgInitialTick() plus a ~20-line pre-script in index.html; long term rebuild from source. My pages use one shared mapLink() helper (/js/links.js).
findings.acceptance_test: Playwright: open /?tick=300 shows TimeModel.label(300) with no splash; Documentary card 10 -> Watch this moment opens that vignette at that tick; same for Regiment ?unit= and Students cards.
depends_on: app patch owned by app agents
findings.metric_or_grade_moved: Core function / UX (Documentary, Students, Regiment, Search, Turning Points, Historian CTAs)
findings.correction: Evidence confirmed (no reader except ancestor at bundle.pretty.js:101019, in the deploy or any archived bundle; emitters incl. search.html:114,127,139, turning-points.html:118, historian.html:110). The minimal patch fails: splash tO overwrites currentTick each frame (:101494) and resets to 1 (:101500, Skip intro :101576); it mounts while vn is false (:112948,:113059); layout chooser dO shows while Zn is null (:112949,:113061). Must default vn true (or apply state after onComplete), auto-pick layout, and consume unit/vignette. Effort M-L.

findings.title: Render-blocking Mapbox GL JS and serial waterfall on sandbox/viewshed/ground-remembers
findings.evidence: sandbox.html:19-20, viewshed.html:19-20, ground-remembers.html:15-16 sync <script> in head; curl: mapbox-gl.js 481,197 B gzip / 1,796,551 B raw, max-age=31536000; ~2.4 s on Slow-4G before parse. Inline IIFEs fetch only after it runs; ground-remembers.html:64-73 creates the map only after 9 fetches.
findings.root_cause: Parser-blocking head script, data fetch serialised behind it, map created after data, no placeholder.
findings.fix: Remove sync script; shared /js/map-loader.js loads mapbox-gl async (preconnect api.mapbox.com, dns-prefetch events.mapbox.com, preload only if above the fold); start data fetch at top of body in parallel; create map as soon as script ready; skeleton with aria-busy removed on map.once('idle'); init via requestIdleCallback(2500 ms) or first interaction (facade); cooperativeGestures on viewshed and ground-remembers.
findings.acceptance_test: Lighthouse mobile each page: FCP<=1.8 s, LCP<=2.5 s (LCP is text or poster, not canvas), TBT<=200 ms, CLS<=0.1; filmstrip shows header painted before mapbox-gl.js completes.
findings.correction: Sizes confirmed (gzip 481,197; raw 1,796,551). Browsers get brotli 385,039 B so ~1.9 s not 2.4 s. Preload as=script with crossorigin plus an injected script without crossOrigin = double download; drop crossorigin (ACAO is *). loadMapbox must also await the CSS. Skeleton placement: see pagesB-49.

findings.title: No error, retry, empty or offline state on any data fetch
findings.evidence: documentary.html:70-72, education.html:65-67, regiment.html:131-135, sandbox.html:85, ground-remembers.html:64, viewshed.html:60: Promise.all(fetch().then(r=>r.json())) with no r.ok check or try/catch; a single failure leaves 'Loading...' forever (regiment.html:73).
findings.fix: Shared /js/data.js loadJSON with timeout, retries, r.ok check and showError(role=alert, 44px Try again); wrap every boot in try/catch; noscript fallbacks once prerender exists; map.on('error') UI; explicit empty states (no match, no units at this moment).
findings.acceptance_test: Playwright route.abort() on one data file shows an alert with Retry and no uncaught error; offline reload of a visited page works.
findings.correction: All six pages use fetch().then(r=>r.json()) with no r.ok/try-catch; lines verified.

findings.title: Request fan-out, data bundling and cache/SW strategy
findings.evidence: Fetch counts: documentary 3, education 3, sandbox 9, ground 9, regiment 20 (369 KB raw / ~79 KB gzip); live files tiny (7 KB, 5.9 KB, 2.6 KB brotli) so cost is requests and sw.js network-first + cache.put per /data file; netlify.toml:28-30 max-age=3600 without hashed names.
findings.fix: Build vignettes.all.json, placements.all.json, oob.all.json, names.json with content hashes (/data/v/<hash>/), tiny manifest.json; immutable caching for hashed files; SW stale-while-revalidate for /data/v/*; regiment fetches oob.all first and lazy-loads placements/vignettes.
findings.acceptance_test: Regiment page makes <=2 data requests before first interaction; repeat visit makes 0 network data requests.
findings.correction: Counts/sizes confirmed (20 files, 368,893 B raw, 79.8 KB gzip; OOB 181,612 B; sw.js:61-70; netlify.toml:27-30). Caveat: /data/v/<hash>/ still matches /data/* (max-age=3600) and Netlify concatenates same-name headers from overlapping rules; use a non-overlapping path (e.g. under /assets/) or verify with curl -I.

findings.title: Adopt a single shared time-model module
findings.evidence: Pages hard-code dayForTick (documentary.html:84, regiment.html:189), DAY_TICK_RANGES (education.html:63), raw tick labels (documentary.html:89, regiment.html:218-219, ground-remembers.html:47), sandbox ticks 260/553/62 (sandbox.html:103-107). Four different clock formulas exist in the deploy (bundle.pretty.js:9370 start 6:00 day1 / 4:00 days2-3; :100838 and :101001 5:00 with July day+2; :97428 day+2; chronology tick_formula 5:00 + 5 min).
findings.fix: /js/time-model.js: dayOf, tickInDay, dateOf (never day+2), piecewise-linear clockMinutes over an ANCHORS table, formatClock, label, tickForClock, simMinPerTick; unit-tested; all seven pages consume it. Time-model owner decides Option A (anchor table over existing ticks, recommended first) vs B (re-time data).
findings.acceptance_test: node:test: dayOf boundaries 225/226/450/451; clockMinutes strictly increasing; label(anchorTick) equals authored anchor clock; nothing returns 'July 5'; tickForClock round-trips within 1 tick.
findings.correction: Formulas verified (9371, 100836-100842, 100998-101006, 97428); drift table recomputed. Minor: Day 2 is -10 through tick 340, -50 at 360. tickForClock snippet is pseudo-code.

findings.title: Layout-shift risk: placeholders replaced by taller content, footer jumps, nav mount
findings.evidence: documentary.html:52-53, education.html:52-53, regiment.html:73 swap ~100 px Loading block for 600+ px content while footer (site-nav.css:127-135) is visible on phones; viewshed.html:53 #ranking (30 rows) filled after map load; site-nav.js:161-171 replaces empty #gtbg-nav-mount with ~57 px sticky nav at DOMContentLoaded.
findings.fix: #gtbg-nav-mount{min-height:57px}; main{min-height:calc(100dvh - 57px - 140px)}; skeletons at final height; render #ranking from terrain JSON before map load; aspect-ratio on poster images.
findings.acceptance_test: Lighthouse CLS<=0.02 on each page (mobile); Playwright layout-shift sum<=0.05.
findings.correction: Code-reading finding; nav ~55 px. min-height variant safe; flex-column variant has the pagesB-12 pitfall.

findings.title: Accessibility baseline missing on all seven pages
findings.evidence: grep: zero aria-* on all seven pages; no skip link; no <main> on sandbox/viewshed/ground-remembers; titles are <div> (documentary.html:57, aftermath.html:50); maps unnamed (sandbox.html:62, viewshed.html:52, ground-remembers.html:52); tab state only by class (education.html:48-50); no live regions; regiment.html:70-71 search unlabeled; smooth scroll ignores reduced motion (documentary.html:96, regiment.html:248).
findings.fix: Skip link + <main id=main>; h1>h2>h3 outline; role=region + aria-label on maps with text/table equivalents; aria-live status regions; tablist or aria-pressed toggles; combobox pattern; reduced-motion checks; axe-core wcag2a/2aa/22aa gate in CI.
findings.acceptance_test: axe 0 violations at 320/375/768/1440 and landscape; manual NVDA and VoiceOver run of each page.
findings.correction: aria- count is 0 on all seven pages; no main on sandbox/viewshed/ground; no h2 on five pages; no skip link, noscript, reduced-motion.

findings.title: Touch targets, type sizes and contrast failures on these pages
findings.evidence: Computed contrast: footer #6f7686 on #0a0a14 4.32 (site-nav.css:129), 2.53 on education blue; .gtbg-group-why 4.08 (site-nav.css:96); sandbox .hint #777 4.15 (:41), controls hint 4.15 (:60), empty list #666 3.43 (:66), timestamp #555 2.64 (:219); regiment hover/focus side-tag 3.53 (regiment.html:31-32); nav focus desc 3.53. Targets: .nav-btn ~37 px, sandbox .btn ~33 px, .play-btn ~33 px, match-row ~36 px; text <12 px: 11 px eyebrow/event-date/tl-meta, 10 px side-tag, 9.5 px gtbg-here.
findings.fix: Tokens --tap:44px and --fs-min:0.875rem; .btn min-height 44px; back links inline-flex 44px; muted text to >=#9aa3b8 or lighten #6f7686; replace #777/#666/#555 with var(--muted); focus rows share hover text colours.
findings.acceptance_test: axe color-contrast and target-size pass; Playwright asserts every button/a/[role=option]/input >=44x44 at 375 px.
findings.correction: All 9 contrast ratios recompute exactly; #9aa3b8 is 7.79:1. Shared nav/footer targets not covered (see missed M2).

findings.title: SEO/social: malformed og:image, missing twitter tags, JS-only content, duplicate URLs
findings.evidence: og:image/twitter:image = /screenshots/day3.png on all seven pages; PNG IHDR says RGB (colour type 2) but IDAT inflates to 3,687,120 B = RGBA rows vs 2,765,520 B expected, Pillow cannot decode; day1.png and day3.png byte-identical (md5 3f6646c99f3416a1aa35fea67bed21c5). regiment.html and ground-remembers.html lack twitter:* and shorten og:description. Documentary/Students/Regiment text is client-fetched only. /regiment and /ground-remembers both 200 (curl). viewshed.html:8,11,17 description claims sightlines.
findings.fix: Generate distinct 1200x630 og images per page (+og:image:width/height/alt) and fix manifest screenshots; shared head partial with all tags; Netlify 301 from extensionless twins; prerender text for Documentary/Students/Regiment; JSON-LD Article/BreadcrumbList/ItemList.
findings.acceptance_test: Facebook/LinkedIn/X card validators render an image for each page; Pillow/browser decode og images; view-source of documentary contains all 24 moments; /regiment 301s.
findings.correction: Malformed PNG reproduced (3,687,120 vs 2,765,520 B; Pillow fails; day1=day3 md5). Extra: data is RGBA alpha 0xFF near-uniform dark (17.6 KB), i.e. a placeholder; fixing IHDR alone won't help. Twin-URL 200s not re-tested (site unreachable).

findings.title: Dev-log copy, internal terms and ' -- ' typography
findings.evidence: viewshed.html:46 'Earlier drafts...'; regiment.html:102 'likely recorded at the brigade level'; regiment.html:66; sandbox.html:54,200; ground-remembers.html:43; aftermath.html:44. Data leaks: union_artillery.json 2nd Maine key_action 'subject of a Gettysburg Animated YouTube vignette', 16th Vermont 'across several ticks'; raw ids shown (regiment.html:198-199 'Indiana · U-I · U-I-1-1', sandbox.html:196). ' -- ' appears 31x in the seven pages and 139x in the 24 vignettes.
findings.fix: Rewrite in museum voice (copy given per page in report); build-time replace ' -- ' with em dash; scripts/lint-copy.mjs fails CI on ' -- ', 'tick' in display strings, youtube/animation/placed-with/must-be in OOB text, and U-/C- ids rendered into the DOM.
findings.acceptance_test: lint-copy passes; grep of built pages finds none of the listed strings.
findings.correction: 31 ' -- ' in the pages; 140 (not 139) in vignettes by JSON dump; dev text at union_artillery.json:91 and union_regiments_i_ii_corps.json:51.

findings.title: Hard-coded Mapbox token and version pins; no map error handling
findings.evidence: Same pk. token literal at sandbox.html:71, viewshed.html:57, ground-remembers.html:56 (and in bundle); mapbox-gl v3.24.1 pinned in 9 HTML files, bundle also 3.24.1 (bundle.pretty.js:53873); no map.on('error').
findings.fix: Single /config.js (MAPBOX_TOKEN, MAPBOX_VERSION); URL-restrict the token in the Mapbox dashboard; map.on('error') mapping 401/403/429 to a friendly 'map unavailable' state; CI check that CDN version equals bundle version.
findings.acceptance_test: Token restricted (foreign Referer gets 403); blocked-token test shows friendly message; CI version-equality check passes.
findings.correction: pk. token literal and v3.24.1 pin appear in NINE HTML files (camera, cinematic-export, compare, ground-remembers, immersive, sandbox, unit-rendering-reference, viewshed, watch-together), not three.

findings.title: Shared page shell: tokens, sticky footer, back-link semantics
findings.evidence: Each page redeclares :root tokens (education.html:20 differs); #gtbg-footer margin-top:40px with no flex column (site-nav.css:130) gives floating footer on short pages; wireBackLinks only rewires a[href="/"] (site-nav.js:212) so documentary/education/aftermath (href=/index.html: documentary.html:47, education.html:42, aftermath.html:41) skip it; history.back() used when referrer is same-origin even if previous entry is another sub-page (site-nav.js:215-216).
findings.fix: /css/tokens.css + /css/shell.css (body flex column, main flex:1, footer margin-top:auto); data-theme for Students variant; Back link always a real <a href=/>, History API only when history.state.fromMap; shared head partial for title/description/canonical/OG/Twitter/theme-color.
findings.acceptance_test: Footer at viewport bottom on 1440x900 and 375x812 with empty Regiment page; Historian -> Documentary -> Back to the map lands on the map.
findings.correction: Evidence confirmed. Fix pitfall: main{max-width;margin:0 auto} inside a flex-column body loses stretch (auto cross-axis margins) and shrinks to content width; add width:100% or width:min(100%,720px).

findings.title: No automated tests for these pages
findings.evidence: No tests, CI, or lint exist in the deploy or reconstructed source for the sub-pages.
findings.fix: Playwright (desktop 1440x900, mobile 375x812, tablet 768x1024, landscape 812x375), axe-core, Lighthouse CI budgets, console-silent gate, overflow/target/type checks, data-lint and copy-lint, unit tests for time-model, joins, heat weights, viewshed core, DEM decode, combobox and sandbox math.
findings.acceptance_test: CI red on any of: axe violation, console message, CLS>0.05, target<44 px, lint finding, golden viewshed drift >1.5 points.
findings.correction: No tests exist; severity arguably medium (process gap); effort L realistic.

findings.title: Documentary narrative renders as one paragraph
findings.evidence: documentary.html:91 el.textContent = v.full_script; .script (documentary.html:34) has no white-space rule; all 24 full_script strings contain \n\n (avg 10.4 paragraphs, 206-375 words).
findings.root_cause: Plain-text paragraphs rendered without splitting; browsers collapse newlines.
findings.fix:
Split on /\n{2,}/ and create

elements with textContent; .script p{margin:0 0 1.1em;max-width:65ch}; reuse anywhere full_script is shown.
findings.acceptance_test:
Playwright: every moment renders >=5

and joined text equals source minus newlines; no horizontal scroll at 320 px.
findings.correction: documentary.html:34,91; all 24 scripts have blank-line breaks (avg 10.4 paragraphs); fix works.

findings.title: Documentary eyebrow shows raw tick beside prose that contradicts the clock
findings.evidence: documentary.html:89 'Day N · Tick T · location'; V-001 prose says ~7:30 am while formula maps tick 12 to 5:55 (chronology label 6:00, map store 6:55); V-002 says ~10:15 am at tick 28 (formula 7:15); V-022 ~7:30 am at tick 460 (formula 5:45); V-017 1:00 pm at tick 518 (formula 10:35).
findings.fix: Eyebrow 'Day 1 · July 1, 1863 · about 7:30 a.m. · location' from new vignette fields historical_time/time_confidence/time_source; never show raw ticks; do not show the map clock on the card until the time-model owner reconciles anchors, then show TimeModel.label(tick) only on the 'Watch on map' link.
findings.acceptance_test: data-lint requires historical_time on all 24 vignettes and matches prose time regex; no 'Tick' string in the DOM.
findings.correction: Prose-time vs formula vs map-store clock table verified cell by cell for all 10 vignettes.

findings.title: Documentary mobile: navigation row overflow and small targets
findings.evidence: documentary.html:35 .nav-row flex space-between no wrap holding Prev (~108 px), a 30-char link (~195 px) and Next (~90 px) vs ~271 px content width at 375 px (stage padding 28/32 px, :31); .nav-btn ~37 px (:36); progress segments are 4 px non-interactive bars (:29). Estimated, verify visually.
findings.fix: clamp padding; grid nav row with link on its own full-width 44 px row; .nav-btn min-height 44; sticky bottom bar on mobile; progress becomes <ol> of buttons with aria-label 'Moment 5 of 24: ...' and aria-current, grouped by day.
findings.acceptance_test: 320/375/414 px screenshots show no wrapped link text or clipped buttons; all targets >=44 px.
findings.correction: Arithmetic confirmed (271.5 px content width, 37 px buttons); wrapping needs a browser.

findings.title: Documentary keyboard, screen-reader, deep-link and focus behaviour
findings.evidence: documentary.html:101-104 global ArrowLeft/Right handler without modifier/target guards; no focus management after step; render() calls scrollTo smooth including first render (:96,:106) ignoring reduced motion; titles are divs (:57); no URL state (refresh returns to moment 1).
findings.fix: Guard key handler and scope to the stage; hash routing #v-010 with replaceState/hashchange; after each step update document.title, focus <h2 tabindex=-1>, announce via aria-live status; scroll only if stage top off-screen and honour reduced motion; <h2>/<article> markup.
findings.acceptance_test: axe 0; keyboard-only pass through 24 moments; screen reader announces new moment; documentary.html#v-013 opens that moment and survives refresh.
findings.correction: documentary.html lines 57, 96, 101-104, 106 verified.

findings.title: Documentary feature completions (read-aloud, map, sources, chapters, prerender)
findings.evidence: site-nav.js:27 advertises 'narrated' but no audio exists; vignettes carry trigger_lat/lng and per-file metadata.sources (Pfanz, Oates, Desjardin, OR) that no page shows; 24 moments = 7,205 words (~36 min).
findings.fix: Web Speech read-aloud (rate/voice/highlight/auto-advance, feature-detected); per-moment mini-map from trigger_lat/lng over 3DEP hillshade; per-moment Sources disclosure; day dividers, chapter menu, resume position, reading-time chips, share, print CSS; end-of-tour links to Turning Points, featured units and Students; prerender 24 <article id=v-###> + JSON-LD ItemList.
findings.acceptance_test: Read-aloud works in Chrome/Safari/Firefox or hides; JS-off page shows all 24; Sources visible; Lighthouse mobile >=98.
findings.correction: Only vignettes_part1.json has metadata.sources (7 entries); parts 2 and 3 (16 of 24 moments) have none, so per-moment sources must be authored. 'narrated' (site-nav.js:27) and lat/lng confirmed.

findings.title: Documentary small defects: hard-coded 24, tick-556 tie, epilogue vignette
findings.evidence: documentary.html:49 and site-nav.js:27 hard-code 'All 24'; sort at :72 is by tick only (V-019 and V-023 tie at 556); V-024 triggers at tick 675 (formula 11:40 pm) but is about the afternoon; back link /index.html (:47).
findings.fix: Render count from data; sort by tick then vignette_id or explicit order field; mark V-024 kind=epilogue; use shared Back link; rewrite .sub copy.
findings.acceptance_test: Count string equals vignettes.length; deterministic order test; epilogue shown last with label.
findings.correction: Tick-556 tie (V-019/V-023), V-024 at 675, hard-coded 24 verified.

findings.title: Students page palette clashes with site and fails footer contrast
findings.evidence: education.html:6,20 blue #0a3a6a palette vs dark navy/gold elsewhere; shared nav (#0d0d18) and footer (#6f7686/#8a93a8, site-nav.css:20,129-133) on the blue page give 2.53:1 text and 3.73:1 links; page's own text passes (>=6.5:1).
findings.fix: Use shared tokens with data-theme=students changing scale not palette (18 px body/1.75, 48 px tabs, larger cards, illustrated header); if a light classroom look is wanted implement a site-wide light theme (prefers-color-scheme + toggle); set shared theme-color.
findings.acceptance_test: axe contrast 0 on Students in every theme; visual regression against shared shell.
findings.correction: 2.53:1 and 3.73:1 reproduce; palette at education.html:20.

findings.title: Students content is not written for students
findings.evidence: education.html:80 renders panel_summary; heuristic Flesch-Kincaid: panel_summary mean 11.1 (median 11.2, range 5.5-16.6) vs full_script mean 7.1; sub promises 'A simple guide' (:44); DAY_INTRO hard-coded (:58-62) with contestable 'both armies were at full strength' (:60).
findings.fix: Author student_summary (<=60 words, grade 5-7) per vignette and student_intro per day in the data with review/source fields; Simple/Detailed toggle (Detailed = full_script paragraphs); per-card key terms glossary, 'Why it matters', 'Meet the people' chips from OOB commanders.
findings.acceptance_test: data-lint FK<=8.0 for student_summary; teacher review sign-off.
findings.correction: Direction reproduces with own heuristic (panel_summary FK 11.9 vs full_script 7.4). panel_summary already averages 59 words, so a <=60-word target changes vocabulary, not length.

findings.title: Students tabs, innerHTML injection, no-JS and link semantics
findings.evidence: education.html:48-50 class-only tab state, no tablist; tabs inert until data loads (listeners attached after await :86-92); innerHTML with DAY_INTRO and v.title/v.panel_summary (:75,79-81); identical link text 'See it on the map' on every card (:81); no #day-2 deep link; no server-rendered text.
findings.fix: role=tablist/tab/tabpanel with roving tabindex (or aria-pressed toggles); aria-disabled until data ready; build nodes with textContent; link text 'See The Railroad Cut on the map'; #day-1..3 hash; prerender all three days and only toggle visibility in JS.
findings.acceptance_test: axe 0; keyboard tab test; JS-on and JS-off DOM text equal; each link has unique accessible name.
findings.correction: Listeners attached after await (education.html:86-92); innerHTML at 75, 79-81; identical link text verified.

findings.title: Students classroom kit and feature completions
findings.evidence: Page has only day tabs and cards; no progress, practice, printable, teacher notes or read-aloud.
findings.fix: Progress tracker (localStorage try/catch), 3-5 client-side self-check questions per day (no data collection), print CSS worksheets, Teacher notes page (goals, 45-min plan, vocabulary), shared Read-aloud/Share; standards alignment only after teacher review (C3 Framework, state history/ELA literacy: candidates, not claims).
findings.acceptance_test: Print preview fits one page per day; quiz works offline; no network beacons; axe 0.
findings.correction: Feature proposal; no factual claims to check.

findings.title: Aftermath thin content, no citations, weak semantics
findings.evidence: aftermath.html:48-67 four events for 4.5 months, no sources/images/map links; timeline is divs; dates 11 px (:32), caveat 12 px (:27).
findings.fix: Expand to ~15-20 dated entries in five chapters (retreat; pursuit and the river; town and wounded; the dead and the cemetery; the Address) as <ol> with <time datetime>, 60-120 words each and 1-2 citations (NPS, Coddington, Sears, OR: every fact needs a source before publishing; none verified here); related-unit and map links; rewrite caveat as 'About this timeline' with a sources list; reuse the site's single sourced casualty figure.
findings.acceptance_test: Every entry has <time>, >=1 citation and passes link checker; axe 0; Lighthouse 100 all categories.
findings.correction: Four events, 11 px dates, 12 px caveat verified; sourcing caution appropriate.

findings.title: Aftermath fact-check list for existing text
findings.evidence: aftermath.html:51 (Vicksburg same day, rainstorm, wagon train 'stretched for miles'); :56 (Potomac, Williamsport, crossing by July 14, Lincoln's criticism); :61 'roughly 2,400 residents'; :66 'Cemetery Hill -- ground your map shows...' (National Cemetery adjoins Cemetery Hill); Everett ~2 h, Lincoln ~2 min.
findings.fix: Add citations for each claim, verify the 1860 population figure, reword 'beside Cemetery Hill', keep 'about two minutes' with source.
findings.acceptance_test: Each sentence maps to a cited source in the page's sources list.
findings.correction: Do not reword to 'beside Cemetery Hill': NPS says the Soldiers' National Cemetery was established on Cemetery Hill. The loose phrase is 'the Union army's central anchor' (verify). Population/duration figures still unverified.

findings.title: Sandbox edit panel appears in the wrong place

findings.title: Sandbox not operable by touch or keyboard (WCAG 2.5.7 / 2.1.1)

findings.fix: Add touchstart/touchmove/touchend handlers with preventDefault and dragPan.disable during a hold, rAF-throttled setData; click-to-move alternative (tap unit, tap Move here); keyboard: unit table with Select buttons, arrow-key nudge 50 m (Shift 200, Alt 10), Enter/Esc, Ctrl+Z, aria-live announcements; chooser list when several units overlap (e.features[0] is arbitrary, :169).
findings.acceptance_test: Playwright touch emulation moves a unit; keyboard-only move and undo; axe 0.
findings.correction: Touch drag unsupported (sandbox.html:167). But Mapbox registers touchstart passive (bundle.pretty.js:90324) and only touch-pan preventDefaults (:89498), so a tap likely triggers synthesized mousedown and opens the mispositioned panel; 'tap never opens' should be dropped/verified. touchstart is preventable, touchmove is not (:89049-89066); attach touchmove on the map. WCAG 2.5.7/2.1.1 conclusions stand.

findings.title: terrain.json coordinates and elevations do not match USGS 3DEP

findings.title: Real viewshed: USGS 3DEP DEM pipeline
findings.evidence: EPQS at LRT returns resolution 1 m, AcquisitionDate 11/4/2017, rasterId 122544; ImageServer exportImage works without a key (5 m UTM export 1928x1824 = 15.7 MB TIFF in ~17 s); first EPSG:4326 export mis-registered by 33-87 ft, UTM square-pixel export matched EPQS within 1 ft. Sizes (terrain-RGB PNG, 0.1 m): 5 m 1.65 MB, 10 m 0.54 MB, 15 m 0.28 MB, 30 m 0.09 MB. USGS says 3DEP products are free without use restrictions; USGS data public domain, credit requested.
findings.fix: scripts/build-dem: export square-pixel rasters (EPSG:3857 for the overlay; margin bbox W -77.32 E -77.14 S 39.74 N 39.88 at 10 m plus 5 m core), average-resample from 1 m COG, quantise to Mapbox-formula terrain-RGB PNG (decode with createImageBitmap colorSpaceConversion:none, strip gAMA/iCCP), hashed immutable files under /data/dem/, meta.json (bbox, cell, datum NAVD88, source, retrieved, credit), hillshade WebP poster; CI verifies 20 random points vs EPQS <=1 ft.
findings.acceptance_test: 20-point EPQS check <=1 ft; 10 m core PNG <=0.6 MB and 5 m <=1.7 MB; files hashed and immutable.
findings.metric_or_grade_moved: Enables real viewshed; SEO/poster for map pages
findings.correction: ImageServer (F32, 8000 max, keyless export 200), EPQS, USGS 'free of charge and without use restrictions' / public domain, PNG sizes 1.65/0.54/0.28/0.09 MB all reproduce. ImageServer resampling isn't area-average; averaging implies downloading 1 m tiles.

findings.title: Real viewshed: worker, ray-casting algorithm and overlay
findings.evidence: Prototype (numpy/Node) on 3DEP bare earth, eye=target=1.7 m, R=5 km, k=0.13: numpy 0.33-0.42 s for 7.2 M samples; Node/V8 236 ms (R=5 km, 5 m), 56 ms (R=3 km), 44 ms (10 m step); LRT crest 52.5% visible (33.0 km2), Big Round Top 76.8%, Angle 10.6%, Seminary Ridge 7.3%, Cemetery Hill (off-crest) 3.3%; 5 m vs 10 m vs 15 m differ <=1.4 points; target height 0 vs 1.7 m: 33.2% vs 52.5%; LRT at listed coords 1.8%.
findings.fix: Module worker: fetch DEM PNG -> createImageBitmap -> OffscreenCanvas -> Float32Array; radial ray casting with running max slope, bilinear sampling, curvature+refraction drop d^2(1-k)/(2Re), Re 6,371,000, k 0.13, N=ceil(2*pi*R/cell) rays; generation-id cancellation and progress; stats (visible km2, % within 1/2/5 km, farthest per 10-degree sector); mask -> ImageData -> Mapbox image source with mercator-aligned corners and updateImage; raster layer with opacity slider and nearest resampling; default 10 m/R=3 km on mobile, upgrade to 5 m on desktop when idle.
findings.acceptance_test: Golden numbers from the prototype within +/-1.5 points; 10 m compute <400 ms desktop and <1.5 s mid-phone; no main-thread long task; INP<200 ms.
findings.correction: Numbers and curvature math reproduce (horizon 4.99 km; drop 1.707 m at 5 km; Node 33-108 ms here). Spec ambiguity: if the DEM is EPSG:3857 (~6.5 m px), the worker's cell must be ground metres (5 m), else distances/curvature inflate 1.30x; store cell_ground_m and cell_mercator_m in meta.json. Quote only the area-weighted 52.5% (vs.js prints sample-weighted 58.6%).

findings.title: Real viewshed: obstruction modelling and validation
findings.evidence: 3DEP is bare earth (no trees/buildings/smoke); modern canopy differs from 1863 and NPS has restored woodlots since the 1999 GMP; NPS vegetation inventory GIS for GETT is listed on catalog.data.gov (licence unverified); Warren 1868-69 and Bachelder maps are period sources; an NPS/Seminary GIS study of Lee's cupola view exists per search.
findings.fix: Stage 0 terrain-only with explicit label; Stage 1 modern first-return lidar DSM-DTM as an upper-bound 'today' view; Stage 2 1863 layer (woodlots, orchards, thickets, buildings digitised from period maps and/or NPS vegetation data, assumed heights per class each cited or labelled assumption) with toggle 'Terrain only / With modelled 1863 woods and buildings'; validate with synthetic-DEM tests, golden tests, cross-check against GDAL gdal_viewshed/GRASS r.viewshed (not run here) and >=10 cited historical sightline assertions, publishing disagreements instead of tuning.
findings.acceptance_test: >=10 cited assertions evaluated and published; accuracy statement in 'How this works'; independent implementation agrees within 2 points on 5 vantage points.
findings.correction: NPS 1999 GMP woodlot/orchard rehabilitation confirmed. NPS Vegetation Mapping Inventory exists on catalog.data.gov (accessLevel public, no licence text, 2003 imagery/2006 dataset): modern-vegetation product, weak 1863 proxy, licence unstated. Warren/Bachelder not checked.

findings.title: Mapbox terrain-DEM boundary and 3D first-person view
findings.evidence: Docs summary (fetched): tileset mapbox://mapbox.mapbox-terrain-dem-v1, height=-10000+((R*256*256+G*256+B)*0.1), zoom<=14 (~7.3 m/px at 39.8N by arithmetic), available only via Mapbox SDKs not Raster Tiles API, mixed datums, attribution required; ToS summary restricts caching beyond normal browser behaviour, bulk extraction and derivative datasets. Not tested with the site's token.
findings.fix: Do not feed Mapbox DEM values into the viewshed (compute from USGS 3DEP). Use Mapbox terrain for rendering only: raster-dem source + setTerrain exaggeration 1.0 + fog, free camera at vantage using ground height from our 3DEP DEM + eye height and lookAtPoint(target) for a first-person 'look toward X' view; keep Mapbox attribution; same 'terrain only' caveat.
findings.acceptance_test: Camera never below ground at all vantage points; attribution visible; no code path reads Mapbox DEM values for computation.
findings.correction: SDK-only, zoom 14, formula, attribution confirmed. Restrictions are in Mapbox Product Terms (2026-07-21) s1.6 (no tracing/deriving/extracting), s1.9 (no bulk/scraping/caching), s2.8.1 (30-day device cache; no static-image distribution), not in /legal/tos. '~7.3 m/px' assumes 256-px tiles; docs give no resolution; with tileSize 512 it is ~3.7 m/px. Relabel or delete.

verification_summary: Evidence in pages-B is high quality. I re-ran the data joins, contrast math, PNG defect, USGS EPQS and ImageServer queries, DEM payload sizes and the viewshed prototype, and nearly every number reproduced (the exceptions are the exact heat-experiment figures and a few miscounts noted below). Deploy line cites match. The live site was unreachable from the verifier host, so live-curl claims (TTFB, twin-URL 200s) were not re-tested. The material errors are in the proposed fixes, not the findings: (1) pagesB-01's minimal deep-link patch fails because the splash overwrites and resets currentTick (bundle.pretty.js:101494/101500/101576); (2) pagesB-02's preload uses crossorigin against a non-CORS injected script, so the file downloads twice; (3) pagesB-12's flex-column shell collapses `main{max-width;margin:0 auto}` to content width; (4) pagesB-49 puts a poster inside #map, which triggers Mapbox's 'container should be empty' warning (bundle.pretty.js:92787); (5) pagesB-27 wrongly says a tap never opens the sandbox panel; (6) pagesB-25's 'beside Cemetery Hill' rewording contradicts NPS; (7) pagesB-40 cites /legal/tos, but the restrictions are in Mapbox Product Terms s1.6/1.9/2.8.1. Other corrections: only vignettes_part1 has metadata.sources (pagesB-18); the Mapbox token appears in 9 HTML files, not 3 (pagesB-11); U-20ME is featured in V-009 and V-010 (pagesB-43); the Union/Confederate split is 273/193 (pagesB-53). The biggest scope gap is that the terrain.json coordinate defect also affects vignette triggers and placements. Verification section appended to pages-B.md (report file was appended to; nothing else modified).

missed_by_specialist.title: OG/PWA image capture must not contain Mapbox map content
missed_by_specialist.evidence: pagesB-09 proposes headless capture of pages (three show Mapbox basemaps). Mapbox Product Terms 2026-07-21 s2.8.1 forbids distributing Licensed Map Content 'by using a screenshot or other static image'; s1.7.3 limits static/print rights. The report already avoids Mapbox tiles for the Ground poster for this reason.
missed_by_specialist.fix: Generate /og/*.png and manifest screenshots from 3DEP hillshade plus first-party art (or confirm Static Images API terms); lint rejects captures from pages with a Mapbox canvas.

missed_by_specialist.title: Header-rule overlap for proposed hashed data path
missed_by_specialist.evidence: netlify.toml:27-30 sets /data/* max-age=3600; /data/v/<hash>/* (pagesB-04) also matches and Netlify concatenates same-name headers across overlapping rules (docs silent; consistent with X4 embed.html), risking 'max-age=3600, ..., max-age=31536000, immutable'.
missed_by_specialist.fix: Serve hashed files from a path matched by exactly one rule (e.g. /assets/data/<hash>/, immutable at netlify.toml:22-25) and verify with curl -I on a deploy preview.
